title: Heavenly Blueberry Muffins
description: Light, fluffy muffins crowned with a crisp crumble and bursting with juicy blueberries — built for quiet mornings and empty plates.

method.instruction: Preheat oven to 175°C and line a 12-hole muffin tray with paper cases.
Whisk milk and eggs together in a bowl. Gradually whisk in vegetable oil until emulsified.
Add sugar and mix until dissolved.
Sift in plain flour, milk powder, and baking powder. Mix gently until just combined — do not overmix.
Prepare the crumble topping by rubbing flour, butter, and sugar together until coarse crumbs form.
Spoon batter into muffin cases, filling about three-quarters full.
Scatter blueberries over the batter and finish with crumble topping.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until golden and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean.

notes.title: Light Muffins
notes.content: Mix the batter gently and stop as soon as it comes together — overmixing develops gluten and makes muffins tough.

notes.title: Serving Tip
notes.content: Best eaten warm on the day, but excellent toasted lightly the next morning.
